sections.body: Direction puzzles say how someone walks and ask where they end up. The four main directions are North, East, South and West. Facing North, your right hand points East.
Turns: a right turn goes North → East → South → West → North. A left turn goes the other way round. Two turns in the same direction make a half turn, so you face the opposite way.

Always draw a quick map. Put a dot for the start, then add each walk as an arrow. Moving East then West along the same line cancels out. Walk 5 m East, 2 m South, then 5 m West: you end 2 m South of where you began.
To find the straight-line distance, use Pythagoras when the paths make a right angle. Walk 5 km West and 12 km North: the distance is the square root of 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169, which is 13 km.
Draw a map of a walk from your door: 4 steps forward, turn right, 3 steps, turn right, 4 steps. Where are you compared with the start?
Use a real compass or a playground to act the puzzles out. Walking the route is the best way to see why a quick sketch helps.

quiz.q: Sam walks 4 km North and then 3 km East. How far is he from where he started, in a straight line?
hints: Draw the two walks. They meet at a right angle.
Use Pythagoras: the square root of (4² + 3²).
Example: 6 km West and 8 km North → 36 + 64 = 100, whose square root is 10. Use 4 and 3.
quiz.explain: 4² + 3² = 16 + 9 = 25. The square root of 25 is 5 km.

quiz.q: Priya faces North. She turns right, then right again. Which way does she face now?
hints: Turn one step at a time: right of North is?
North → East after the first right turn. Turn right once more.
Example: facing East and turning left once → you face North. Take the two turns one at a time.
quiz.explain: North → East → South. Two right turns make a half turn.

quiz.q: Ben walks 10 m East, then 6 m North, then 10 m West. Where is he compared with the start?
hints: East and West on the same line cancel each other.
10 m East then 10 m West gets you back to the same east-west spot. What is left?
Example: 5 m East, 2 m South, 5 m West leaves you 2 m South. Use the same cancelling idea.
quiz.explain: 10 m East and 10 m West cancel out. Only the 6 m North is left.
